Striveworks builds trusted AI systems for real-world government use cases, monitoring model performance and managing drift after deployment. The Junior Software Engineer will contribute to quality software development, solve meaningful product problems, and help build cloud-neutral, event-driven, microservices-based systems that optimize and deploy AI models and algorithms.
